sources.title: Own information-loss, edit-distance and answer-agreement derivations
sources.details: For fixed H/I, T(x1)=T(x2) yields indistinguishable chat input despite different unencoded acoustic attributes. The unequal four-codepoint reference/hypothesis needs at least one edit and final-character substitution attains one: CER=1/4. Equality compares strings only; both can violate no-spicy rubric, and different nonspicy paraphrases can satisfy it. Full derivation and explicit examples in analysis.md and probe.stdout.txt.
